poses.caption: Lie supported on a flat bench with feet planted and a wide overhand grip on the Smith bar. Lower the bar toward the chest.
Press the bar upward along the guide rails while keeping the body supported, then lower with control.

jobs.prompt: Original premium ADULT male fine detailed anatomical exercise illustration SMITH WIDE GRIP BENCH PRESS canonical1308. TWO equal SQUARE cells side by side WIDE LANDSCAPE2:1, same model proportions machine bench camera scale. Front-side three-quarter view whole model lies SUPINE on FLAT gray bench head LEFT feet RIGHT, skull shoulders back pelvis supported pad, BOTH feet FLAT wide planted floor, knees90degrees. Complete SMITH MACHINE with TWO VERTICAL GUIDE RAILS either side of bench shoulder area, straight steel BAR locked to sliding CARRIAGES on BOTH rails, modest equal round plates each end. Bar travels VERTICALLY only same rails location each panel. BOTH hands WIDE OVERHAND grip somewhat wider than shoulders, thumbs wrap bar, wrists stacked over forearms. LEFT START bar at MID CHEST light hover just above shirt, elbows bent90degrees OUTWARD roughly60degrees from torso not forced extreme flare, forearms vertical. RIGHT FINISH bar pressed VERTICALLY UP above same midchest line nearly straight elbows, shoulder blades stable on pad, no torso lifting or twist. Same grip/feet/bar load/rails both. Primary BOTH PECTORALS two smooth DIFFUSE RED soft teaching patches over INTACT BLACK chest SHIRT only, NO rays/fibers/striations/pec grooves, no arm/shoulder red. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps front sides back with seams broad cloth folds, MID-THIGH shorts cover front sides back seat crotch no cutaway/transparency/anatomical fibers through cloth. Fine grayscale exposed anatomy realistic hands fingers proportions machine. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows. Uniform SMALL scale entire body bar plates guide rails machine base bench head hands feet within EACH square generous12percent margins no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference STYLE ONLY ignore pushup pose/chest fibers. No labels text captions arrows.
